title: Smoking (BN as PDG)
note: A Bayesian network is a PDG with no conflict — Inc ≈ 0. The consistent control case.

title: Chain  A → B → C
note: Structure only, no cpds. Exercises the renderer, not the math.

title: Split and merge
note: Fan-out from A plus a multi-source hyperarc into D.

title: Cyclic  A ⇄ B
note: A 2-cycle. Ordinary Bayesian networks forbid this; PDGs do not.

title: Conflicted (two arcs into B)
note: The 'hello world' of PDGs: two arcs both determine B.

title: Two coins
note: The smallest genuinely inconsistent PDG, and inconsistency here is ASYMMETRIC: `dbl` puts 0 on T, so mass on T is infinitely surprising to it — but not conversely. Optimize → Inc = ∞ (dashed edge, off the end of the colour scale). Set ε = 1e-3 to recover the true minimum, ln 2 ≈ 0.693.

title: Grok — parallel arcs disagree slightly
note: Two arcs T→C that disagree only slightly. Inc ≈ 0.155 — finite, and far below C1's ∞. 'Not all inconsistencies are equally egregious.'

title: Factor graph drift (α = 1 each)
note: Two arcs that AGREE — both carry µ_.7. Yet Score (the factor product) drifts to .845 = .7²/(.7²+.3²), and Optimize to .842. The factor graph moves even though both sources say exactly the same thing.

title: Factor graph fixed (α = .5 each)
note: The same model with α_J1 + α_J2 = 1. Press Optimize: Pr(x1) stays at .700 where the previous example drifts to .842. Score still reads .845 for both — factor_product weights by β only — but its IDef separates them (0 here, .62 there). The diff is one pair of numbers.

title: Tanning bed (BN + one arc)
note: The smoking BN plus a second cause of cancer. A BN would have to rewrite p4 over {S, SH, T}; the PDG just gains an arc — and C now has two opinions, so Inc leaves zero. Five variables, 32 worlds: the distribution drawer is the point.

title: Coin with a modeled bias
note: Naive maxent over {µ_.5, δ_H} returns .5 — the double-headed coin makes NO difference. Model the bias explicitly and .5 becomes unreachable: drag γ from 0 to 1 and watch Pr(H) move 2/3 → 3/4.
